title: fix(metadata-protocol): search titles a reference-typed nameField by its target's title
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgRuogP8Tp8XyFXLc92Bxvo6)_

repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZiaBg6rk7dpy1s9Me

Fixes #34175

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:全局搜索 / ⌘K 面板里,对象的 `nameField` 是引用字段(lookup / master_detail / user / tree)时,命中标题不再显示目标记录的原始 id,而是显示目标记录自己的标题。
- 为什么改:记录页头(`$expand`)和活动时间线早已显示目标名称,只有搜索面板还在显示 id,用户无法分辨命中的是谁。
- 风险与回滚:目标标题按搜索者本人身份读取(对象权限、行级范围、字段级安全全部生效),被拒的读者仍只看到 id;每个被搜对象只多一次批量读取。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-record-reads.ts` 的 `readReferenceTitles`(读取身份与拒绝分支),其次同文件 `searchAll` 中 `hitRows` 一段(批量收集 id)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol.search-title-lookup.test.ts`,预期 11 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`searchAll` → `renderTitle` returned `row[nameField]` as stored. When the pointer is a reference field, that value is the target record's id, so the palette titled such a hit by a raw key. Now:

- The per-object sweep collects the pointer's ids from the rows it will turn into hits and reads the target's ADR-0079 title pointer (`nameField`, else the deprecated `displayNameField`) in **one** `find(target, { where: { id: { $in } }, fields: ['id', title], limit })` per swept object. No N+1 per hit.
- The target is the spec's `referenceTargetOf` answer (the same arbiter the `$expand` gate and engine ask), so `user` resolves to `sys_user` with no `reference` declared, and `tree` follows too.
- **The read is the searcher's**: the caller's `context` goes to `find`, so the target's object gate, row scope and FLS apply as they do to `$expand`. A reader refused the target keeps the bare id:
  - the target's declared exposure does not serve `get` (`canServeApiOperation`) → not read;
  - `canReadObject(target)` false → not read;
  - the read throws `PERMISSION_DENIED` → no titles;
  - a row outside the row scope, or a title column FLS strips → that id keeps its value.
- A target read that fails otherwise propagates, the same disposition the sweep gives a failing record read; a target whose table was never provisioned titles nothing (`isMissingTableError`).
- The hit's wire shape does not change: `record` still carries the stored id, no `$expand` on the palette `find`. Only `title` changes.
- No import from plugin-audit (`resolveLookupTitles`); metadata-protocol sits below it and below objectql.
- The exposure decision is its own small function, `servesSearchTitleTarget`, and the new reference-target read is classified as a `decided` read in `packages/core/src/security/second-object-read-exposure.pin.test.ts` (`CALLERS`, plus the pinned list of decision functions). That pin reds any unclassified caller of `referenceTargetOf`. It was red on this PR's earlier head (Test Core 6/10) and is green now.

## Tests

New `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.search-title-lookup.test.ts` (11 cases): the title follows `lookup`, `master_detail` and `user`; one target read per swept object, as the searcher, `id` + title only; the wire shape; four refused-reader legs (object refused before the read, refusal thrown by the read, row scope, FLS strip); exposure without `get`; an outage propagates with its envelope (`code` + `status`); a text pointer pays no extra read.

## Acceptance notes

- Measured on `main` first, at d6d9645056, with the new test file: the PIN answered `{ pm_1: 'per_1', pm_2: 'per_2', pm_3: 'per_1' }`, so each hit was titled by the stored lookup id. 7 of 11 failed on main. The 4 that passed there are the refusal, exposure, wire-shape and control legs, which hold on main because main never follows the reference.
- The card's named stock producer, `sys_record_share.recipient_id`, is a **`Field.text`** column (a polymorphic principal id read with `recipient_type`), not a reference field. So this fix does not change that object's palette title. Following it needs the `recipient_type`-keyed directory read the console's `recipient-picker` face does, which is a separate design. Stock objects with a reference `nameField` in this repo are `sys_scim_subject` (`searchable: false`) and `sys_session` (skipped by name prefix), so no stock object reaches the palette through this path. The reach is app objects, for example HotCRM's `crm_project_member` behind #34055.
- `referenceNameVisible` (ruling 6574398310) is not served here. A refused reader keeps the bare id, as the dispatch states. Serving a refused reader the target's name needs a system-context read, which is a new disclosure decision and not in this card.
- One hop only: a target whose own title column is itself a reference shows that column's stored value.
- A multi-valued reference pointer titles each element and joins them with `, `. When nothing resolves, the value is rendered exactly as before.
- The `searchAll` method docblock in `protocol.ts` is not edited because it is outside this claim's file surface. The contract text for the new read is on `readReferenceTitles` and at the call site.

Tests  7 failed | 4 passed (11)
```
</details>

```
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (committed fix, then mutated, then restored)</summary>

Deleted `if (canReadObject && !(await canReadObject(target))) return titles;` with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: anchor 1 to 0, blob 35ced7511b80 to f92c32c63df5. Result: `× REFUSED — an object-level refusal keeps the bare id, and the target is never read`, `Tests 1 failed | 10 passed (11)`. Restored: blob equals HEAD (35ced7511b80) and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates and CI</summary>

Final head ff64484d3d. `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 69 families. All 69 were run locally and every one exited 0. `dispatch-gates --ran` reported: 69 accounted for, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, exit 0. Pre-push `overlap-check` gave VERDICT clean exit 0.

Along the way:

- `check:test-source-alias` failed on the new test file because it needed a module-top `import '@objectstack/lint'`. Fixed in 7e664c7da9.
- `check:lean-entry-closure` first exited 3 because the objectql dist had not been built. After building objectql it exited 0.
- On 7e664c7da9, CI `Test Core (6/10)` failed on the core `second-object-read-exposure` pin because the new caller was not yet classified. Fixed in ff64484d3d; locally that pin gives `Tests 4 passed (4)`.
- CI `Test Core (8/10)` hit a 5000 ms timeout in `plugin-security` `org-admin-assignment-boundary.posture.test.ts`. That file is untouched here. Locally it gives `Tests 104 passed (104)`, and it is green on ff64484d3d.

CI check-runs on ff64484d3d: every non-skipped run has `completed/success`. That includes `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core` (10/10 shards), `Build Core`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Test UI`, `Type Check UI`, `Build & E2E UI`, `Live E2E UI`, `Dogfood Regression Gate` and `Check Changeset`.
